howToUse.title: Go to Codify
howToUse.description: Access Codify via the website and log in or sign up.

howToUse.title: Describe Your Code Needs
howToUse.description: Write a natural language prompt describing the snippet or module you want.

howToUse.title: Receive and Edit Code
howToUse.description: Review generated code, edit, or refine as needed.

howToUse.title: Copy or Share
howToUse.description: Export the code or share with your team via the platform.
